fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. 2 Letters of recommendation * 2. Resume or curriculum vitae in English. * 3. Degree certificate and degree authentication provided by a THU recognized institution. * 4. Electronic copy of official transcripts or academic records for every post-secondary university or college attended. If your institution provides a cumulative grade point average and/or a class rank for your degree, please make sure to include it. * 5. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be at least 2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. * 6. Chinese name -A Chinese name of applicant is necessary. * 7. Employment or Income Certificate of the Financial Sponsor An employment or income certificate of the financial sponsor. * 8. Personal Statement (up to 800 words) Describing why you want to apply for the Dual Master Degree, your professional interests and values (including study, internship, and research etc.), and future career plans. 9. Additional materials that demonstrate qualifications and experience (e.g. HSK certificate, published papers, patents, or portfolios). * 10. English language proficiency certificate * 11. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 12. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included * 13. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -The official website has included the CSCA transcript among other previously required exams such as the SAT in the exam requirements section. However, the application system does not specify the subjects required for different majors yet. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1 Applicants must be foreign nationals who do not hold Chinese nationality in accordance with the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China. At the time of application, applicants must hold a valid foreign passport or other valid proof of foreign nationality (Please see: Eligibility Instructions for Tsinghua University International Undergraduate Applicants (Nationality Status) 2027). 2 Applicants should be in good physical and mental health, demonstrate goodwill toward China, and hold a valid high school graduation certificate. The high school educational qualification must have been obtained through full-time, in-person education. 3 Academic performance Outstanding academic performance. Proof should be provided by (but not limited to) the following document(s): 3.1 High school/University (if applicable) transcripts (in Chinese or English). 3.2 Certificate of National/Regional Graduation Examination/Matriculation Examination (e.g. ATAR/Abitur/BAC/CSAT/UEC/STPM/others). 3.3 Results of international standardized tests (e.g. CSCA/SAT/ACT/A-Level/AP/IB/ others). 3.4 Other Supporting Materials. 4 Language proficiency Applicants must have a high level of English language proficiency. For those with a native language other than English, a test report of English language proficiency will need to be provided (e.g. TOEFL/IELTS/others). 5 Aged 18 or above (by September 1, 2027). For the applicants under 18, please bring the relevant supporting documents to the official registration. Applicants under 18 must present a Guarantee Statement of Guardian in China and relevant supporting documents at the time of registration. 6 Applicants must meet the requirements outlined in Document No. 12 (2020) of the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China, as well as Eligibility Instructions for Tsinghua University International Undergraduate Applicants (Nationality Status) 2027. Applicants who do not meet the above requirements or fail to submit all required materials to the application system in accordance with the Submission Requirements for Tsinghua University International Undergraduate Applicants Regarding Nationality Status Documentation 2027, will be deemed ineligible to apply.
